operations.name: get_book
operations.summary: Get one catalogue entry by ISBN.
operations.when_to_call: Call when you know a book's ISBN and need its title and year.
operations.response_description: Object with isbn, title and year.
operations.evidence_quote: GET `/books/{isbn}` returns the catalogue entry for the book with that ISBN.

operations.name: search_authors
operations.summary: Find authors whose name contains some text.
operations.when_to_call: Call when you need author records matching part of a name.

operations.name: list_daily_recommendations
operations.summary: List the books recommended for today.
operations.when_to_call: Call when you want today's recommended books for a mood.
operations.evidence_quote: GET /discover/daily returns a fresh list of recommended books every morning.

operations.name: create_review
operations.summary: Post a review for a book.
operations.when_to_call: Call when the user wants to publish a review of a book.
operations.evidence_quote: GET `/books/{isbn}` returns the catalogue entry for the book with that ISBN.
